how_to_apply: Visit the official website at https://iwai.gov.in/ to download the notification and prescribed proforma.
Fill out the application form either in Hindi or English in block letters.
Affix a self-attested passport-size photograph on the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates of educational qualifications, experience, and last 5 years' APARs (from 2021-2022 onwards).
Ensure the application is forwarded through proper channel by your parent office or department, along with the filled certificate from the Head of the Department/Authorized Signatory with seal.
If delay is anticipated through proper channel, send an advance copy to reach before the closing date.

Send the completed application in a closed envelope superscribed “Application for the post of Section Officer on deputation basis, against Employment Notice No. IWAI-17011/5/2025-ADMIN RECTT Dated 08.10.2026” through Registered Post or Speed Post only.
Address the application to the Assistant Secretary (Admn. & Estt.), Inland Waterways Authority of India, A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201301 (U.P.).
important_instructions: The Authority follows Central Govt. Rules & Regulations in service matters. The post carries all India transfer liability. Mere possession of essential qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be selected. Canvassing in any form shall be a ground for disqualification. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date or not received through proper channel are liable to be rejected. The period of deputation shall initially be for a period of 03 years and shall not ordinarily exceed 3 years.

faq.question: Q1. What is IWAI Section Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IWAI Section Officer Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment notification issued by the Inland Waterways Authority of India to fill 2 vacancies for the post of Section Officer on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IWAI Section Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Section Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IWAI Section Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 45 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News, which falls on 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for IWAI Section Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a degree from a recognized university or institute and be holding an analogous post or the post of Assistant in Level 6 in the pay matrix with 5 years regular service.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IWAI Section Officer?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 56 years on the closing date of application.
